description: This PHP controller class handles the editing of job vacancies within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. It extends a Vue controller to prepare a Vue component with relevant properties such as vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size for attachments.

classes.name: EditJobVacancyController
classes.description: A controller class that prepares a Vue component for editing a job vacancy, populating it with vacancy-specific data and configuration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with data from the HTTP request and configuration service before rendering.
